entries.en: SDK: Added canUseTool callback support for tool confirmation
entries.zh: SDK：新增用于工具确认的 `canUseTool` 回调支持

entries.en: Windows: improve permissions checks for allow / deny tools and project trust. This may create a new project entry in `.claude.json` - manually merge the history field if desired.
entries.zh: Windows：改进允许/拒绝工具和项目信任的权限检查。这可能会在 `.claude.json` 中新建一个项目条目，如需保留，请手动合并 history 字段

entries.en: Enhanced /doctor command with CLAUDE.md and MCP tool context for self-serve debugging
entries.zh: 带有 CLAUDE.md 和 MCP 工具上下文的增强 /doctor 命令，用于自助调试

entries.en: Improved file suggestions performance in large repos
entries.zh: 改进大型仓库中的文件建议性能

entries.en: Fix incorrect model names being used for certain commands like `/pr-comments`
entries.zh: 修复某些命令使用的不正确的模型名称，例如`/pr-comments`

entries.en: Windows: improve sub-process spawning to eliminate "No such file or directory" when running commands like pnpm
entries.zh: Windows：改进子进程启动方式，消除运行 pnpm 等命令时出现的 "No such file or directory" 报错
